objective: If CPU in CPUからLLMのキック requires an architectural CPU core, select one real CPU source before importing code.

selected_candidate.name: Ibex
selected_candidate.candidate_role: single real CPU core candidate for an RV32 CPU-to-LLM-proxy kick gate
why_selected: Ibex is a small 32-bit RISC-V CPU core written in SystemVerilog.
Ibex is close to the current OpenTitan-oriented repository context.
The lowRISC public material describes Ibex as suitable for embedded control, which matches a CPU-side accelerator kick role.
The repository is Apache-2.0, which is compatible with submodule-based evaluation subject to exact license verification before import.

first_gate_shape.program: minimal RV32 software image writes seed/shape/tensor registers, writes kick, polls done for Q/K/V stages, then halts
first_gate_shape.bridge: minimal MMIO bridge from CPU data bus to existing pulp_quantized_kv_cache proxy control registers
first_gate_shape.comparison: CPU-vs-hybrid coverage-output equivalence over CPU-visible kick/done/proxy output words

source_evidence.finding: The repository identifies Ibex as a small 32-bit RISC-V CPU core and contains RTL under an Apache-2.0 license.
lowRISC describes Ibex as an open-source embedded RISC-V processor with OpenTitan usage and embedded-control fit.
PicoRV32 is a smaller RV32IMC-oriented option, useful as a fallback if active surface is prioritized over OpenTitan affinity.
VeeR EL2 is a real RISC-V core, but the repo policy already removed VeeR/XuanTie active source and warns against restoring them casually.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: PicoRV32
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: Likely smaller active surface, but less aligned with the existing OpenTitan/lowRISC context than Ibex.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: VeeR EL2
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: This repository intentionally archived VeeR-EL2 source and runtime hooks; restoring it would violate the current surface-reduction direction without a stronger reason.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: XuanTie E902
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: This repository intentionally archived XuanTie-E902 source and runtime hooks; restoring it would undo prior active-surface reduction.

must_decide_before_import: whether to use Ibex simple system or bare core only
coverage-output words that prove Q/K/V kick, poll, done, and proxy output progress
must_not_do_before_import_gate: vendor Ibex source directly into overlays/
restore archived VeeR-EL2 or XuanTie-E902 active sources
claim RV32 compliance from the existing tiny instruction-ROM CPU
claim full LLM inference or serving throughput
